chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Thunder is the voice of the angel, and lightning is his whip."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام say thunder and lightning are?
ai.summary: This hadith describes thunder and lightning in relation to an angelic agent. It presents these natural phenomena as signs connected to the unseen order under Allah's command.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The thunder is the voice of the angel, and the lightning is his whip."
